# Boiler Service 2025

## Summary

Annual service on 9 October 2025. The same engineer as last year, about seventy minutes on site including a chat about the radiator balancing I still had not got round to. The benchmark sheet was signed and the reminder card stuck inside the door for next year.

## Findings

A sticking diverter valve was the main issue; hot water was creeping into the heating circuit when only a tap was running, so the radiators warmed when they should not. The flue gas CO2 reading came back at 8.9%, within range. Combustion looked otherwise clean, no sooting at the burner, and there were no leaks at the pump or the pressure relief pipe. The magnetic filter was cleaner than last year.

## Actions

The engineer replaced the cartridge in the diverter valve rather than the whole body, which kept the cost down. Combustion was left unchanged. I was told to keep an eye on the system pressure for the first week in case any air worked loose, and to book the balancing visit in spring if the radiators still run uneven. The old cartridge went in the bin and the valve was tested twice before the engineer left.
